description:
## Why

Tie `.6`, `.7`, `.8`, `.9` together. `Interactive.state.transcript :: [entry]` becomes `%Transcript{}`. `apply_partial` / `finalize_assistant` collapse into `Transcript.update` / `Transcript.finalize`. The block-id plumbing from `.6` lands in `AssistantMessage` content via `.9`. Width and theme changes cascade from `Transcript.resize` / `retheme` down through nested per-message state.

## Depends on

- `opi-4dx.6` (agent block ids)
- `opi-4dx.7` (Markdown.Render)
- `opi-4dx.8` (Transcript module)
- `opi-4dx.9` (AssistantMessage recursion)

## Code references

- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex:1685-1744` — `apply_partial` / `finalize_assistant`.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex:1746-1762` — `find_last_assistant`; replace with id lookup.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex:2243-2244` — `render_entry`.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex` — width/resize handler (search for `:resize` / width updates).

## Shape

- `Interactive.state.transcript` is a `%Transcript{}`.
- `MessageStart` / `MessageUpdate` / `MessageEnd` from agent → `Transcript.append` / `update` / `finalize` keyed on the agent's message id.
- Each AssistantMessage entry holds its own Transcript-shaped block state (per `.9`); the message's renderer in the outer Transcript delegates to `AssistantMessage.render` which walks the inner shape.
- The render path returns an iolist; `Interactive` hands that to the terminal write path (no flat `[String.t()]` allocation).
- Width change: Interactive calls `Transcript.resize/3`.

## Acceptance

- A long conversation (≥ 10 finalized messages) with one streaming message: per-tick `transcript.render` cost is flat in finalized message count.
- No `List.replace_at` calls left on the streaming hot path.
- All existing TUI integration tests pass.
- `key.latency` p50 stays sub-millisecond at mailbox=0; the regime where finalized-message rendering contributed to per-tick cost is gone.

## Tests

- Existing `interactive_test.exs` and `interactive_integration_test.exs` continue to pass.
- New test: streaming a long response while holding a multi-message history; assert `markdown.render` telemetry fires only on the streaming message's pending tail and not on finalized history.
title: Wire-up: Interactive uses Transcript; thread agent ids end-to-end
